title: Stevens links X and Y chromosomes to sex
summary: Stevens saw that male mealworms make two kinds of sperm, one with a large chromosome and one with a small one, linking chromosomes to sex.
why: First link between a visible chromosome difference and a trait.

notes.problem: Title claims sole discovery; source: 'Edmund Wilson made similar discoveries to her around the same time'.

unsung.contribution: Showed sex is determined by chromosomes (the XY system); Edmund Wilson reached similar results independently at the same time.
unsung.recognition: Many authors credited Wilson alone for the discovery; Thomas Hunt Morgan has also been credited.
